topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I walked past the spot where I used to play, the place where I planted that sapling so many years ago. It was supposed to grow with me, a symbol of my growth, a silent witness to all the years. But now, the ground is bare, and there's a fresh scar where the tree once stood tall. I can see the cut stump, barely noticeable, hidden by the overgrown weeds. I keep thinking, maybe I came to the wrong spot, or maybe I didn’t remember correctly. But deep down, I know. The tree is gone, and with it, a piece of my childhood. I just can’t seem to move, not yet.
